html:
Japan is the island country off the east coast of Asia, made up of four main islands and many smaller ones. The map uses the plain name Japan in many years from 800 to today, across several very different eras.

  • Early states: rice farming came with the Yayoi culture, and the Yamato kings united much of the country by the 500s.
  • Court rule: in the Nara and Heian periods emperors ruled from capitals on the Chinese model, above all Heian-kyō, now Kyoto.
  • Shoguns: from 1185 warrior governments held real power, through the Kamakura and Muromachi shogunates and the civil wars of the Warring States period.
  • Edo: the Tokugawa shoguns kept peace from 1603 and limited contact with the outside world.
  • Modern Japan: the Meiji Restoration of 1868 began rapid change into an industrial empire. After defeat in 1945 and American occupation, modern Japan rebuilt as a democracy and one of the world's largest economies.
